title: Plastic Tumbler Glass Set, 4-Piece 'Ombre' by Sugar & Cloth
text: Plastic Tumbler Glass Set, 4-Piece 'Ombre' by Sugar & Cloth. 4 tiny plastic tumbler 'glasses' in mint green, peach, pink, and blue, holds 6 ounces. Not designed for dishwasher or microwave. Fine to handwash and eventually disposable when they start to look shoddy. I think these are ideal for casually elegant functions initially and then reuse for travel or beach or picnic.  I searched the company website and could not find more information on this product.

description: A pretty set of tumblers can take you from brunch to after dinner drinks. Serve anything from bloody mary's to margaritas in these pretty pastel ombre tumblers. From party plates to serveware & champagne coupes, Sugar & Cloth is the perfect way to dress up your table (and avoid the dishwasher)!
